          "literal": "/// Reads a regular file of at most `max` bytes. Devices, directories and larger files are\n/// refused before their content is read.\npub fn read_bounded(path: &Path, max: u64, what: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, DriverError> {\n    let file = File::open(path).map_err(|e| DriverError::Io(format!(\"{what}: cannot open {}: {e}\", path.display())))?;\n    let meta = file.metadata().map_err(|e| DriverError::Io(format!(\"{what}: cannot stat {}: {e}\", path.display())))?;\n    if !meta.is_file() {\n        return Err(DriverError::Io(format!(\"{what}: {} is not a regular file\", path.display())));\n    }\n    if meta.len() > max {\n        return Err(DriverError::Input(format!(\"{what}: {} bytes exceed the {max}-byte bound\", meta.len())));\n    }\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    file.take(max.saturating_add(1))\n        .read_to_end(&mut out)\n        .map_err(|e| DriverError::Io(format!(\"{what}: cannot read {}: {e}\", path.display())))?;\n    if out.len() as u64 > max {\n        return Err(DriverError::Input(format!(\"{what}: file grew beyond the {max}-byte bound while read\")));\n    }\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\n/// Reads a source file as UTF-8 text.\npub fn read_source(path: &Path) -> Result<String, DriverError> {\n    let bytes = read_bounded(path, MAX_SOURCE_BYTES, \"source\")?;\n    String::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| DriverError::Input(\"source: not UTF-8\".into()))"
        }

pub(crate) fn identifier(name: &str) -> bool {
    let mut bytes = name.bytes();
    matches!(bytes.next(), Some(b'A'..=b'Z' | b'a'..=b'z'))
        && name.len() <= 64
        && bytes.all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_')
        && !matches!(
            name,
            "language"
                | "agreement"
                | "state"
                | "asset"
                | "action"
                | "input"
                | "let"
                | "next"
                | "requires"
                | "ensures"
                | "emit"
                | "transfer"
                | "fee"
                | "liability"
                | "discharge"
                | "true"
                | "false"
                | "and"
                | "or"
                | "not"
                | "UInt"
                | "Bool"
        )
}

          "literal": "    fn binary(&self, cs: &mut Cs<F>, op: BinaryOp, a: CVal<F>, b: CVal<F>) -> Result<CVal<F>, GadgetError> {
        let shape = |m: &str| GadgetError::Static(format!("operand types differ from validated IR: {m}"));
        Ok(match (op, a, b) {
            (BinaryOp::Add, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::U(gadgets::add(cs, "add", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Sub, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::U(gadgets::sub(cs, "sub", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Mul, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::U(gadgets::mul(cs, "mul", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Lt, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Gt, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &y, &x)?),
            (BinaryOp::Le, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &y, &x)?)),
            (BinaryOp::Ge, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::lt(cs, "lt", &x, &y)?)),
            (BinaryOp::Eq, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::eq_uint(cs, "eq", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Ne, CVal::U(x), CVal::U(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::eq_uint(cs, "eq", &x, &y)?)),
            (BinaryOp::Eq, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::eq_bool(cs, "beq", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Ne, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::not(&gadgets::eq_bool(cs, "beq", &x, &y)?)),
            (BinaryOp::And, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::and(cs, "and", &x, &y)?),
            (BinaryOp::Or, CVal::B(x), CVal::B(y)) => CVal::B(gadgets::or(cs, "or", &x, &y)?),
            (op, _, _) => return Err(shape(&format!("{op:?}"))),"
        }
